description:
Changes the plan in one call, as the person asked: add an intent, update one (its name, what its page says, or on and off), approve (switch on) a list, remove a list, or reorder (the order is build priority). Changes apply in that order and stop at the first one the product refuses; the ones before it are saved and the error says so.
An intent that is on gets a page when generate_pages is called. To start with one page, switch the others off with update, not remove: they stay in the plan for later. An intent whose page is built cannot be removed, only switched off.
Returns the plan after the changes. Never put another app's name into a page's name or message: a competitor's name is a keyword only.

keywords.description: Keywords from the app's keyword field this page claims. One that is on another page moves here.

message.description: What the page says to that person.

name.description: The intent, in a few words: what the person is searching for.

targets.description: For a page reached from ads and links: the searches an ad bids on, or an audience.

app_id.description: The app's id in Pagefully (a UUID), as analyze_app returned it in app.id.

locale.description: An App Store language, such as en-US. Leave it out for the app's own language.

remove.description: Intent ids to take out of the plan.

reorder.description: Every intent id, in the new order.

on.description: true: a page is wanted. false: it stays in the plan and no page is made.

name: update_plan
title: Update the plan
